title: This Frog Vanishes When It Falls Asleep (Its Blood Is Gone)
subject: glass frog

scenes.text: This frog vanishes the moment it falls asleep.
Awake, its belly is see-through. You can watch its heart beat inside a body about an inch long.
Asleep, it becomes up to sixty percent more transparent. In 2022, scientists finally worked out how.
The secret is its blood. Red blood cells absorb light, so the frog hides them.
Nearly ninety percent of its red blood cells leave circulation and pack into its liver, which swells by about forty percent.
So the frog that disappears in its sleep? It's hiding its own blood.

description:
This frog vanishes the moment it falls asleep.
In a 2022 study in Science, researchers found glass frogs move almost 90 percent of their red blood cells into the liver, and become far more see-through.
Would you have guessed blood was the giveaway?
first_comment: Which would you rather be able to do: turn see-through or hide your blood in your liver?
